integrity: Analytical finite-residue proof and exact-rational executable checks; no independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact classifications are for constant-rate directed Markov cycles and Taylor end-step polynomials of orders one through four.
The all-two-state result concerns the classical fourth-order Runge–Kutta polynomial and nonstationary spectral stability.
The theorem does not cover arbitrary generators, nonlinear problems, positivity of intermediate stages, or floating-point implementation.
Searches do not establish publication priority; specialized prior literature may overlap.
title: Sharp cycle-length positivity frontiers for fourth-order Runge–Kutta
